assets.prompt: Ghost-hunting vacuum backpack unit: an upright rounded cylinder canister with a flat back plate, two small round gauges and a glowing violet light strip on the front, a short hose connector at the bottom. Clean game-ready low-poly topology, clean PBR texture without baked shadows.
